[h3] 13F (2024) PC by Hushy (Chinese) [/h3] 13F is an Exit 8 game, which in turn, a recent evolution to those spot the difference games that began in early print. The only difference being that instead of simply spotting the differences between two pictures, now your required to spot the sly differences between two nearly identical game levels. In 13F, you are an employee on the 13th floor of a building and over worked, madly typing like your Jerry Lewis in the Typewriter song. Building management has noted that overstretched workers often hallucinate and inform you via bulletin that it is your responsibility to safely navigate your way to the first floor avoiding any harmful variation from normal floor plans you stumble across in subsequent floors below. If you discover an anomaly, you are encouraged to make your way back upstairs to progress downward and if you see no anomaly on a floor, then your expected to make your way downstairs as normal. It is imperative that you take note that the instruction is to go UPSTAIRS if you see an anomaly and not to simply go left. The reason for this, is that sometimes the stair wells themselves can be the anomaly and their positions are switched, or some floors can have 2 upstairs, especially where the anomalies you come across, require you to have quick reflexes to avoid danger. There are 35 anomalies to discover in total and these are kept track of in game thanks to a page with a building that has 35 windows needing to be lit. One window per anomaly found. This page also has 6 special achievement windows that turn purple when the special achievements are discovered and then decorative in game items are also added as rewards. The only problem is that finding an anomaly does not erase it from the pool and the anomaly that you need to complete your found collection, may indeed take a while before it is added to your run again. Only anomalies discovered in completed runs where you manage to get to safety and exit the building are registered as discovered. Anomalies that you find on a run where you are either killed or fail to spot one, are always reset as not completed. The special achievements can also stump players. They involve returning a rabbit doll to a crying girl, trying to use a working elevator, taking less than 5 minutes and more than 10 minutes to complete the game and physically patting the cat on every level as you descend. In final, A 2D exit 8 hand drawn clone where the objective is to make it to the safety of the first floor and exit the building. Normal floor plan is demonstrated on floor 13 and thereafter once you have gone downstairs you must look out for deviations from the original floor plan. There are 35 in total. Some are obvious and require you to perform various tasks to survive the encounters, others are very, very subtle. The anomaly known as the Gnathosaur I personally found it to be inconsistent with its attack when coming across it and often left me vexed in frustration. Then there were cheeky anomalies that were not obvious unless clicked, like the Bulletin note being changed on the odd occasion. Eventually though you will become an expert and aware of where the 35 anomalies can pop up and then the game will then have limited replay value. None of the head ripping ghosts, the skeletal charging aliens, or the murderous mental patients posing as security guards will ever get to kill you, because you will be ready for them. [h2]13F｜8.7/10｜“八号出口系”恐怖观察：氛围拉满，规则清晰，上头又好入口[/h2] [h3]一句话总结[/h3] [b]玩法简单易懂，但气氛做得很硬：越走越不对劲，越玩越想把这一局走对。[/b] [h3]玩法（Gameplay）[/h3] 核心规则很直观：观察环境、识别异常、做出选择、推进流程。 几乎不需要学习成本，开局几分钟就能进入状态，而且“错一次就重来”的结构非常上瘾。 [h3]氛围（Atmosphere）[/h3] 压迫感很强，属于那种不靠大段剧情，而是靠空间、细节、节奏让我们心里发毛的类型。 越熟悉路线，反而越容易被细小变化吓到，心理战做得很到位。 [h3]美术与呈现（Visuals）[/h3] 画面风格很抓人，整体观感统一，既有辨识度也有“脏脏的恐怖感”。 在这种观察类玩法里，可读性和冲击力都很重要，它做得挺稳。 [h3]节奏与重复游玩（Pacing & Replay）[/h3] 流程短、反馈快，很适合反复尝试。 如果我们喜欢“八号出口”这种不断确认与纠错的循环，13F 的爽点会非常对胃口。 [h3]小缺点（也许）[/h3] [list] [*]因为核心机制偏纯粹，玩到后面可能会更依赖“异常点设计是否够惊喜”来维持新鲜感。 [*]偏好重剧情/重谜题长线推进的玩家，可能会觉得它更像“高浓度短体验”。 [/list] [b]评分：8.7/10[/b] [b]一句话安利：想要强氛围、低门槛、短平快但很上头的恐怖观察体验，13F 很值得一玩。[/b]
这游戏过程中的煎熬等等，在到达一楼的时候都会烟消云散，你也会感到无比的舒畅。
最开始是看老e和zc玩的，就想着买的试下，八号出口的玩法，流程不长体验不错，说实话我觉得像素游戏倒挺适合八号出口这种类型的，毕竟不会像有些第一人称的类似作品，抠细节扣的让人想吐（倒也不是说13f没扣细节的地方，但像素风好记而且数量不会很多）
